item.title: Gremlin-Console
item.description:
Gremlin-Console is an interactive client developed by TinkerPop. Users can use this client to perform various operations on Graph. For traversal syntax and examples, see the Gremlin Query Language guide. There are two main usage modes:

  • Stand-alone offline mode — Run Groovy scripts against HugeGraph-Core directly without running the Server.
  • Client/Server mode — Connect to a running HugeGraph Server via WebSocket for remote Gremlin execution.
Note

Gremlin-Console is designed for interactive exploration, rapid testing, and debugging. It is not recommended for high-concurrency production environments; use the language-specific client (such as HugeGraph-Client) instead.
